2013 Nissan Quest S: Exceptional Comfort, Smooth Power, and Family-First Versatility
Smooth V6 Performance and Refined Driving Dynamics
The 2013 Nissan Quest S redefines family transportation by delivering a surprisingly agile and composed driving experience. Powered by Nissan’s legendary 3.5-liter DOHC V6 engine generating a robust 260 horsepower, the Quest offers effortless acceleration for highway merging and passing. Paired with Nissan's advanced Xtronic CVT® (Continuously Variable Transmission), power delivery is smooth, quiet, and efficient, delivering an EPA-estimated 25 MPG on the highway. Its wide stance, low center of gravity, and four-wheel independent suspension provide a stable, car-like ride that absorbs road bumps with total ease.

Innovative Interior Space and Smart Cargo Design
Inside, the Quest S offers a bright, spacious cabin designed with modern simplicity and ultimate convenience. Accommodating up to seven passengers comfortably, it features plush seating and generous legroom across all three rows. What truly sets the Quest apart is its innovative flat-folding seat design: both the second and third rows fold forward seamlessly without requiring you to remove heavy seats, revealing a massive, flat cargo floor in seconds. Additionally, a deep, covered rear cargo storage well keeps items out of sight and secures groceries or gear while traveling.

Standard Comfort, Style, and Proven Safety
Even in its well-equipped S trim, the 2013 Quest comes loaded with features designed to elevate every trip. Passengers benefit from dual-zone climate control with second- and third-row vents, full power accessories, ambient interior lighting, and an intelligent Push Button Ignition with Nissan Intelligent Key®. On the outside, sleek rear privacy glass, distinctive wraparound rear window styling, and standard 16-inch wheels give it a modern, sophisticated silhouette. Supported by Nissan’s advanced airbag system, vehicle dynamic control, and anti-lock brakes, the 2013 Nissan Quest S is a supremely comfortable, safe, and smart choice for active families on the go.

              Comfort
              • Heated driver and front passenger seat cushions - That's hot. Heated driver and front passenger seat cushions provide more targeted warmth so you can get comfortable quicker in cold weather. If you have lower body pain, you might also be soothed by the heat while you drive. No matter the weather, find comfort in heated driver and front passenger seat cushions.
              Convenience
              • Cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, cruise control.
              Safety and Security
              • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
              • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
              • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
              • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
              Technology and Telematics
              • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
              • Apple CarPlay smart device wireless mirroring
              • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.
              • Voice activated integrated navigation system - A to B made easy! Whether it's an errand or a road trip, the voice activated integrated navigation system will guide you to your destination. No more bulky, impossible-to-fold maps, and no more stopping to ask for directions. Just tell it where you want to go, and the voice activated integrated navigation system shows you the right way.

TIMELESS ASTON MARTIN DESIGN

The Silver exterior highlights the Vanquish's sculpted bodywork, muscular rear haunches, signature Aston Martin grille, and elegant grand touring proportions.

2020 FORD MUSTANG ECOBOOST

Premium Pre-Owned Sports Coupe – 60,360 Miles

Few vehicles capture the spirit of American performance quite like the Ford Mustang. For more than half a century, the Mustang has represented an appealing combination of unmistakable styling, rear-wheel-drive dynamics, and everyday driving enjoyment. This 2020 Ford Mustang EcoBoost, with 60,360 miles, delivers that experience through a modern turbocharged powertrain, athletic handling, and the timeless proportions that have made the Mustang one of America's most recognizable sports cars. Offered through the Premium Pre-Owned inventory at Infiniti of Boerne, this Mustang presents an opportunity to enjoy authentic sports coupe performance while benefiting from the professional inspection and preparation standards of an award-winning luxury dealership.

What makes this Mustang particularly appealing is its balance. It delivers engaging performance without requiring the operating costs traditionally associated with larger-displacement muscle cars. Its turbocharged four-cylinder engine provides substantial horsepower and torque, while its rear-wheel-drive architecture preserves the driving character enthusiasts expect from a Mustang. For buyers searching for a pre-owned Ford Mustang near San Antonio, this EcoBoost offers an attractive combination of performance, style, practicality, and value.

TURBOCHARGED PERFORMANCE WITH MUSTANG CHARACTER

Beneath the Mustang's sculpted hood is Ford's 2.3-liter EcoBoost turbocharged four-cylinder engine, producing 310 horsepower and 350 lb-ft of torque in its standard configuration. Those figures give the Mustang impressive acceleration and responsive everyday performance, particularly when merging onto highways or accelerating out of corners.

Unlike traditional front-wheel-drive sporty cars, the Mustang sends power to the rear wheels. This fundamental difference contributes to its balanced handling character and creates the engaging driving experience that has defined the Mustang for generations.

The 2020 Mustang also benefits from a sophisticated independent rear suspension, allowing it to deliver composed handling and improved ride quality compared with the solid-rear-axle Mustangs of earlier generations. The result is a sports coupe equally comfortable navigating San Antonio traffic, cruising along Interstate 10, or exploring the winding roads of the Texas Hill Country.

Electric power-assisted steering, a low seating position, and the Mustang's substantial torque delivery contribute to a driving experience that feels connected and rewarding. This is a vehicle designed for someone who genuinely enjoys the journey, not simply the destination.

ICONIC DESIGN THAT NEVER GOES OUT OF STYLE

The Mustang's exterior design remains one of its strongest selling points. Its long hood, short rear deck, muscular rear shoulders, and distinctive fastback roofline create a silhouette that is instantly recognizable.

The 2020 model builds on that heritage with a modern interpretation of classic Mustang design. Its aggressive front fascia, sculpted body panels, signature three-bar taillights, and dual exhaust outlets reinforce its performance-oriented identity without sacrificing the elegance of a well-proportioned sports coupe.

Inside, the driver-focused cockpit continues the theme. Deeply recessed instruments, a substantial center console, supportive front bucket seats, and intuitive control placement create an environment designed around the person behind the wheel.

The Mustang's 2+2 seating configuration adds a degree of practicality that many dedicated sports cars cannot match. The rear seats provide flexibility for occasional passengers or additional belongings, while the enclosed trunk makes the Mustang more useful for commuting, weekend travel, and everyday errands.

For someone who appreciates automotive design, the Mustang offers something increasingly uncommon: a distinctive personality that remains recognizable from virtually any angle.

MODERN PERFORMANCE WITHOUT UNNECESSARY COMPROMISE

One of the most compelling aspects of the EcoBoost Mustang is its ability to deliver substantial performance from a relatively compact engine.

Turbocharging allows the 2.3-liter engine to produce the kind of torque traditionally associated with considerably larger engines. The result is responsive acceleration without the fuel consumption typically expected from a high-output V8 sports coupe.

This balance makes the EcoBoost particularly appealing to drivers who want a genuine performance vehicle that can also serve as their primary transportation.

Whether you're commuting between Boerne and San Antonio, traveling to Austin for the weekend, or enjoying an evening drive through the Hill Country, the Mustang provides a sense of occasion that ordinary sedans and crossovers rarely deliver.

Its combination of power, rear-wheel-drive dynamics, and everyday usability makes it an attractive choice for first-time sports car buyers, driving enthusiasts, and anyone looking to add more enjoyment to their daily routine.

PREMIUM PRE-OWNED STANDARDS AT INFINITI OF BOERNE

A performance-oriented vehicle deserves thoughtful evaluation, particularly when it has accumulated more than 60,000 miles. Mechanical condition, maintenance, and proper preparation are important considerations when purchasing any pre-owned sports car.

That is why Infiniti of Boerne approaches its Premium Pre-Owned inventory with a commitment to professional inspection and reconditioning.

Every Premium Pre-Owned vehicle is inspected by experienced INFINITI and ASE Certified Technicians. Vehicles are evaluated against Infiniti of Boerne's internal reconditioning standards, with necessary reconditioning recommendations addressed as appropriate before the vehicle is offered for retail sale.

This process focuses on the mechanical and cosmetic condition of the vehicle, helping ensure that each Premium Pre-Owned offering meets the dealership's expectations for presentation and preparation.

Every vehicle is also professionally detailed before delivery, creating an ownership experience that reflects the standards customers expect from a luxury automotive retailer.

For buyers considering a pre-owned Mustang, this approach adds meaningful value. Rather than focusing exclusively on appearance or advertised pricing, Infiniti of Boerne emphasizes professional evaluation, thoughtful preparation, and transparency throughout the purchasing process.

The objective is straightforward: help customers make informed decisions and enjoy greater peace of mind from the beginning of ownership.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY IN AMERICAN PERFORMANCE

The Ford Mustang has maintained its appeal because it delivers something that cannot be measured entirely through horsepower figures or equipment lists.

It makes driving enjoyable.

This 2020 Mustang EcoBoost offers much of the character associated with more expensive performance vehicles while providing an accessible entry into rear-wheel-drive sports coupe ownership.

Its 310-horsepower turbocharged engine, distinctive fastback design, independent rear suspension, and practical cabin create an appealing combination for drivers who value both performance and everyday versatility.

At 60,360 miles, professional inspection and preparation become important elements of the overall purchasing decision. Infiniti of Boerne's Premium Pre-Owned standards help distinguish the buying experience by emphasizing the condition and presentation of the vehicle alongside its inherent performance and design.

For shoppers searching for a 2020 Ford Mustang EcoBoost for sale in Texas, a pre-owned Mustang near Austin, or a Premium Pre-Owned sports car in the San Antonio area, this vehicle deserves serious consideration.

AN AWARD-WINNING DEALERSHIP EXPERIENCE

Purchasing a Mustang should be as enjoyable as driving one.

Infiniti of Boerne is a locally owned and operated luxury dealership serving customers throughout San Antonio, the Texas Hill Country, and communities across the state.

Recognized as the first INFINITI retailer in Texas to earn the 2026 J.D. Power Dealer of Excellence designation, Infiniti of Boerne has built its reputation around customer satisfaction, professional service, and a personalized approach to automotive retail.

The dealership is also a five-time CARFAX Top-Rated Dealer, reflecting its commitment to creating positive customer experiences.

Conveniently located directly off Interstate 10, minutes from La Cantera and The Rim, Infiniti of Boerne is an easy drive for San Antonio-area shoppers. Its combination of Premium Pre-Owned inventory and purchasing convenience also makes it an attractive destination for enthusiasts traveling from Austin, Houston, Corpus Christi, the Rio Grande Valley, and Dallas–Fort Worth.

For customers shopping from outside the area, complete online purchasing is available, along with complimentary home delivery for Premium Pre-Owned vehicle purchases. Out-of-town buyers can also arrange complimentary pickup from San Antonio International Airport.

These conveniences allow customers throughout Texas to enjoy the Infiniti of Boerne purchasing experience without unnecessary travel or complications.

MAKE EVERY DRIVE SOMETHING TO LOOK FORWARD TO

The 2020 Ford Mustang EcoBoost is a reminder that driving can still be rewarding, engaging, and genuinely enjoyable. Its turbocharged performance, rear-wheel-drive handling, unmistakable styling, and everyday practicality create a compelling sports coupe for drivers who appreciate more than basic transportation.

Combined with the professional inspection, reconditioning standards, and personalized customer experience at Infiniti of Boerne, this Mustang offers an attractive way to experience one of America's most celebrated performance cars.
